name: g_builtinTable
evidence: probe result: both tables located by their name strings (docs/spec/as2/README.md)

name: g_scriptGlobalTable
evidence: probe result: both tables located by their name strings (docs/spec/as2/README.md)

name: g_entities
description: entity pool: 1024 entities of 0x1e3 bytes in v1.70 (engine-behaviour.md)

name: g_entityFreeList
description: head of the entity free list (engine-behaviour.md)

name: g_entityLiveList
description: list of live entities walked by the frame loop (rcsl-vm.md)

name: g_entityLiveHead
description: newest live entity; start of the newest-first walk (rcsl-builtins-semantics.md)

name: g_players
description: player records (0x171 bytes each in v1.70; script fields p_*) (rcsl-vm.md)

name: g_cameraQuakeAmount
description: camera quake amount set by CameraQuake (rcsl-builtins-table.md)

name: g_cameraField9
description: camera field 9 reset to 1.0 at level start (hmap.md)

name: g_cameraQuakeTime
description: camera quake state cleared by CameraQuake (rcsl-builtins-table.md)

name: sl_argPointer
description: argument pointer of the running builtin (the current thread's frame) (rcsl-vm.md)

name: g_paused
description: game paused flag; also set by EndLevel (rcsl-vm.md)

name: g_gameReady
description: G_Init done; G_Frame does nothing before (engine-behaviour.md)

name: g_cheatUsed
description: a cheat was used (rank 'Cheater'; no score posting) (engine-behaviour.md)

name: g_difficultyTable
description: difficulty factors (16 bytes per level) (frontend.md / engine-behaviour.md)

name: g_missionUnlockTable
description: mission unlock table (33 bytes per entry) (frontend.md)

name: g_levelPointerTable
description: pointer table used by the random level pick (hmap.md)

name: g_fontAdvance
description: font advance widths in virtual pixels (render-pipeline.md)

name: g_weaponDefs
description: weapon definitions: 0x2c-byte records from weapons/*.wpn (at most 256) (engine-behaviour.md)

name: r_lights
description: per-frame light list (at most 32 lights of 0x34 bytes) (render-pipeline.md)

name: r_blendMode
description: current blend mode of the blend state cache (render-pipeline.md)
evidence: manual: the first value compared by the Direct3D blend-state switch 0x0042fb50 (the automatic alignment picked the device pointer, because the two functions are rewrites)

name: t_heightCopy
description: pristine copy of the height field (hmap.md)

v170_address: # Globals of AS2 only (no v1.70 counterpart); v170_address empty.

name: d3d_object
evidence: stores the result of the Direct3DCreate8 call in the Direct3D initialisation 0x0042f9d0 and calls through it

name: d3d_device
evidence: loaded before every device method call (SetRenderState; SetTexture; BeginScene; ...) in the renderer

name: r_vertexBuffer
evidence: locked through vtable slot 11 by R_LockVertexBuffer 0x0042f070

name: r_vertexBufferUsed
description: vertices used in the dynamic vertex buffer since the last discard (AS2 only)
evidence: compared against 0x1000 and advanced by R_LockVertexBuffer 0x0042f070

name: g_objectCount

name: g_objectNames
